get.summary: OAuth protected-resource metadata for the MCP endpoint
get.description: RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata, public (no sign-in): resource (the MCP endpoint's URL, from -Dmcp.publicOrigin or the request's scheme and Host), authorization_servers (the issuer the install's Authenticator accepts), scopes_supported (-Dauth.oidc.scopes, else openid) and bearer_methods_supported [header]. An MCP client follows the WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata of a 401 from /mcp here, then signs in at the issuer with authorization code and PKCE. Raw JSON, never the v1 envelope. 404 when no sign-in names an issuer. Served under /api/v1 (and /api/v1/spaces/{id}); a reverse proxy may alias the RFC's root path to it. Standard edition and above.

404.description: No OAuth sign-in is configured on this install.

post.description: One JSON-RPC 2.0 request of the Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP, revision 2026-07-28; 2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18 served statelessly for clients that open with initialize). Methods server/discover, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read. Every MCP Tool replays one existing route as the caller, so that route's own policy, capability, agent-gate and masking checks decide; the write tools (propose_change, withdraw_change, propose_action, run_pipeline_now) need a token from an allowlisted agent client (else the tool result is a 403), and propose_change answers the 202 Pending Change another person must approve. Each tools/call and resources/read leaves an AUDIT row naming the person and the verified agent client. The answer is raw JSON-RPC, never the v1 envelope. 400 for a malformed body or a header that does not match the body (-32020) or an unsupported version (-32022); 401 without a credential, carrying WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata pointing at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource when sign-in names an issuer; 403 for a disallowed Origin; 404 for an unknown method (-32601); 413 over 256 KiB; 503 when the install has no sign-in. Standard edition and above.

default.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 response object, or 202 with no body for a notification.
